sloka: अञ्जलिं प्राङ्मुखः कृत्वा पवनायात्मयोओनयो ।ततो हि ववृधे गन्तुं दक्षिणो दक्षिणां दिश्म् ॥५-१-९॥
transliteration: añjaliṁ prāṅmukhaḥ kṛtvā pavanāyātmayoonayo ।tato hi vavṛdhe gantuṁ dakṣiṇo dakṣiṇāṁ diśm ॥5-1-9॥

translations.english: Hanuman, endowed with great equanimity, facing the east and joining his palms by way of salutaion to the Windgod, his father, he enlarged his size and turned south in order to depart.
